r1-0.notes: Strong dutch angle and rich rooftop/town background; fan rests under an open palm instead of being gripped at the pivot (thumb hidden); squiggle on the pocket reads close to scribble text.

r1-1.notes: Clean V-sign and fan grip; half the frame is empty tiled floor.

hard.hands: fail: fan hand is a mitten, fingers fuse into the fan ribs

r1-2.notes: Best background (school and track below) but the fan hand has no readable fingers.

r1-3.notes: Good motion, fan swept out to the side; floor-heavy lower half.

r1-4.notes: On model (twintails, mint ribbons, gold leaf pin, open mint jacket, crest, leggings, sneakers); fan gripped correctly, waving hand five fingers; kick-back pose; background rooftop/trees/town on the left but lower half is plain tiles.

r1-5.notes: Fan drawn as a near-full circle held through its middle; thumbs-up hand fine.

r1-6.notes: Palm laid on the fan ribs (not held); jacket hem billows into an odd extra flap.

checklist.likeness: yes - same girl: cocoa twintails, mint ribbons, gold leaf pin, mint eyes, open mint track jacket with crest, sailor shirt, mint skirt, dark green leggings, white high-tops
checklist.background: rich (rooftop parapet, trees, town and hills; lower half tiled floor)
